name: rotaract-dis
description: Rotaract District Information System — Rotaract District 9218

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev:contracts" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @dis/api && npm run build --workspace @dis/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @dis/api --workspace @dis/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:seed --workspace @dis/api
